author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring Freelance Artists for Character Design & Illustration
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang. Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam: -Character Design & Illustration -Character Sprites -Background & Environment Art -Webtoon / Comic Artwork -Game & Digital Art Assets -Ilustrasi dan visual development lainnya. Kualifikasi: -Memiliki portofolio yang kuat dan dasar menggambar yang baik -Mampu mengikuti art direction yang telah ditentukan atau beradaptasi dengan berbagai gaya visual -Memahami anatomi, komposisi, dan penggunaan warna dengan baik -Mampu menyelesaikan pekerjaan sesuai dengan deadline proyek Terbiasa menerima feedback dan melakukan revisi -Memiliki komunikasi profesional dan etos kerja yang dapat diandalkan. Cara Melamar: Bagi Anda yang tertarik untuk bergabung sebagai freelance artist, silakan kirimkan portofolio dan perkenalan singkat ke: avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com Gunakan subject email: Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda] Dalam email, Anda juga dapat mencantumkan: Jenis artwork yang Anda kuasai atau minati Art style yang biasa Anda gunakan Ketersediaan untuk mengerjakan proyek Rate freelance. Artist yang terpilih akan dihubungi untuk kesempatan berkolaborasi pada proyek-proyek freelance mendatang bersama Avetetsuya Studios.

author: Sealious Seal
title: LF artists who can draw Pokemon (Garchomp, Lucario)
content: LF people who can draw Pokemon You don’t have to be a Pokemon-centered artist or anything, I just want artists who are willing to draw Pokemon or know how 😭 more specifically, Garchomp and Lucario. I usually prefer more anime-esque styles and the OC is cutesy and elegant, but given the Pokemon, I can’t be picky this time around when it comes to the style ,, place your rates and samples in the comments, NO DMS! This is the OC (credit to Miki Fleur) and she will be wearing more fashionable clothes (similar to Emma from Veil) so please be able to draw those too! MOP: GCash, like always

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. (Yes, we're aware AI art has appeared on our channel before, and we'd love to return to using human artists full-time once the budget supports it, and this is part of that plan.) Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!
